root_cause_hypothesis: The immutable source is stored both as one base64 transport and as four deterministic split transport files. The original reconstructor read only the single-file transport and stopped on its transport checksum before the registered fallback parts could be tested.
deterministic_change: Read the single-file transport first; if and only if its whitespace-normalized base64 SHA-256 does not match the already frozen expected hash, concatenate part00 through part03 in lexical order and require that exact same frozen hash. Gzip SHA-256, raw SHA-256, raw byte length, compilation, data dates, features, labels, candidates, costs, latency, exits, stage gates and official-period seals remain unchanged.
